other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: India’s per capita GDP grew at a CAGR of 4.7% as against US’s CAGR of 4.2% between 2010 and 2025.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Source: MoSPI, B2K Analytics India’s per capita GDP (at current prices) increased from Rs 1,88,862 crore in FY2023, to Rs 2,43,803 crore in FY2026, showing CAGR of 8.9% , while in real terms (adjusting inflation) it grew by 6.4% (CAGR) to Rs 2,27,447 crore by FY2026.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Over the last decade (2016 to 2025), the global GVA in Agriculture, Forestry and Fishing grew steadily at 2.7% CAGR and reached USD 4.1 trillion by 2024. 0 50000 100000 150000 200000 250000 2022-23 2023-24 2024-25 (FRE) 2025-26 (PE) Per Capita GDP - Rs Crore (2022-23 Prices) Per Capita GDP Per Capita PFCE Note: Data for Calendar year Source: https://data.worldbank.org/B2K Analytics According to FAO, the global production of primary crops has grown by 27% (an increase of more than 2 billion tonnes) since 2010 and reached 9.9 billion tonnes in 2023.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: In 2024, the global agrochemical market was valued at USD 217.2 billion, and it is forecasted to grow at a CAGR of 4.7% by 2029.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: China dominates due to its large-scale manufacturing, while India’s high CAGR reflects rapid adoption of new farming practices.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Highest adoption of precision agriculture, strong R&D and leadership in agrochemical patents and advanced crop solutions makes US the second highest in market size.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: These countries are expected to continue with the largest market size in 2029 also with China maintaining the lead due to its large agriculture sector and growing domestic manufacturing capabilities.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The global fertilizer market is estimated at USD 132.7 Billion in 2024 and is forecasted to grow at a CAGR of 5.2% to reach USD 171.2 Billion in 2029.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The combination of these factors underpins the steady growth in the global pesticide market which is estimated at USD 84.5 Billion in 2024 and is forecasted to grow at a CAGR of 3.9% to reach USD 102.3 Billion in 2029.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Over the past decade, India’s pesticide exports have grown at a CAGR of 12%, accounting for 9% of the global pesticide export market.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Source: EMIS, Report from Technaivo: Agrochemicals Market in India 2025-2029 The domestic agrochemical market continues to grow which is estimated at USD 22.56 billion in 2024 and is anticipated to grow at a CAGR of 11.8% to USD 39.40 billion in 2029.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The market size of the domestic fertilizer market represents the larger share in the agrochemicals market compared to pesticides.
